Model factor sets, weights, and scoring formulas are UNCHANGED from v1. v1 rows (rows/comparison-rows-2026-10-13.csv) are quarantined from pilot statistics.

immutability_rule: This manifest is immutable. ANY change to a model's factor list, weights, scoring formula, level construction, gate rules, entry rule, cost model, horizon, decision-time definition, veto semantics, venue mapping, or evaluator version requires a NEW manifest version (2.1.0 or 3.0.0). Never edit this file in place.

operational_rules.note: BOTH arms (production AND C-2 challenger) use IDENTICAL operational rules. C-2's ONLY model difference is the removal of the Momentum factor (10 factors vs 11; weight totals 15.5 vs 17.0).

contract_fields.decisionAt: ISO-8601 UTC -- the information-cutoff commit instant (authoritative decision time).
contract_fields.sourceObservedAt: venue/provider observation instant of the decision reference price. DISTINCT from decisionAt: decisionAt is when the decision was committed; sourceObservedAt is when the provider observed the price the decision references. Null only under the degraded rule (crypto fallback path only; equity contracts REQUIRE non-null).
contract_fields.sourceObservationWindow: optional {start, end} bounding the observation interval.
contract_fields.entryObservedAt: venue timestamp of the entry print (the print's own clock).
contract_fields.entryReceivedAt: server receipt time of the entry print (staleness audit).
contract_fields.issuedAt: server time of contract write; MUST be >= decisionAt.

entry_contract.timestamps_ordering: entry print must satisfy decisionAt <= issuedAt <= entryObservedAt <= entryReceivedAt; violations throw ContractError (entry-before-decision, observation-before-issuance, receipt-before-observation).

entry_rule.note: buildContract enforces the per-terminal rule; a mismatch throws.

entry_window.crypto: entryWindowOpensAt = decisionAt; entryWindowExpiresAt = decisionAt + 15 min (cryptoEntryWindowMinutes; explicit UngroundedParam, ENTRY-SEMANTICS.md 6.2). Prints outside the window are never entered (void_expired).
entry_window.equity: next regular XNYS session open; after-hours excluded (equityAfterHoursExcluded=true, explicit param).

entry_contract.drift_limit: driftCapPct: 0.50 equity | 1.50 crypto (explicit UngroundedParams, ENTRY-SEMANTICS.md 6.1). |drift| beyond the cap -> void_drift; a drifted print is never entered.
entry_contract.observation_age_limit: maxObservationAgeMs = 5 min (cryptoEntryWindowMinutes/3, ENTRY-SEMANTICS.md 6.5). The entry rule demands the FIRST post-decision print observed LIVE; a print older than 5 min at receipt time is historical reconstruction, not an actionable entry -- prints older than this bound are SKIPPED (never entered).
entry_contract.anti_fabrication: a contract may only carry entryPrice when evidence is a subsequent observable bid/ask (venue-trade) or an explicitly cost-adjusted quote (cost-adjusted-quote). With evidence 'unavailable', entryPrice MUST stay null -- a fill price is never invented. enterContract REJECTS by THROWING ContractError (never a soft rejection); every rejection carries a machine-readable ENTRY_REJECTION_REASON code.
entry_contract.terminal_states: pending -> entered | void_drift | void_expired | void_no_quote. Voided contracts are logged non-entries: excluded from the accuracy cohort, never scored as MISS. States are terminal.

waiting_interval_veto.repair: GAP-4 (expert, 2026-10-13): the old issuance veto graded [detectedAt, handlerStart] -- actually PRE-decision setup history -- while the real waiting interval [contract.decisionAt, entryObservedAt] was never veto-checked. The repair splits the veto across its two real timestamps.

setup_history_filter.semantics: Bars entirely before the pre-decision cutoff (endAt <= preDecisionAt, clamped to <= decisionAt) are classified as setup-history FEATURES. A pre-decision extreme that crossed the final published stop is RECORDED (detail.historicalCrosses) -- evidence ABOUT how the setup formed, NEVER a stop-out against it. Yesterday's stop crossing cannot veto a new setup. This check NEVER fails: classificatory, not a veto.

decision_to_entry_invalidation.window: [contract.decisionAt, entryObservedAt] -- the genuine waiting interval. entryAt < decisionAt throws (time-incoherent interval; never guess).
decision_to_entry_invalidation.semantics: A touch is a touch: any adverse extreme TOUCHING the final published stop in the waiting interval invalidates the setup (fail). Per-bar handling (inherited from checkSetupInvalidation, fail-closed): bar entirely before decisionAt -> feature (never veto); bar straddling decisionAt or entryAt -> definite pass only if the whole-bar extreme provably could not have crossed; otherwise UNCERTAIN/fail-closed (the pre-event portion is never treated as a definite breach and cannot be isolated from OHLC); bar fully post-decision -> normal extreme check; null/incoherent OHLC -> UNCERTAIN; no post-decision bars -> UNCERTAIN ('issuance-validation unavailable'), except the equity overnight gap (session-close -> next-open carries no bars BY CONSTRUCTION: allowEmptyInterval=true passes with the explicit reason 'no bars by construction', never uncertain). Forming candles are admitted (provisional) so an immediate entry needs no completed candle.
decision_to_entry_invalidation.separation: The result's checks carry the setup-history filter and the decision->entry invalidation as SEPARATE check entries, so a reader can see which question failed.

waiting_interval_veto.qualification_time: runQualificationChecks (issuance time, entry not yet observed): pipeline-order guard (the veto must grade the FINAL published stop) + setup-history filter + entry-zone rules. Deliberately NO decision->entry invalidation at qualification -- the waiting interval does not exist yet; it is graded by checkWaitingInterval at entry observation. Uncertain fails closed.

venue_mapping.rule: ENTRY_VENUE_ACCEPTED_PRINT_LABELS (entry-rules.ts:83): contract entryVenue -> accepted print venue labels. A TradePrint's venue label MUST be in the accepted set for the contract's entryVenue, or the print is SKIPPED (never entered). Anti-cross-venue: an entry observed on the wrong venue is not the contract's entry, even if the price is inside the drift cap.
venue_mapping.fallback: Unknown entryVenue values fall back to exact-label match (fail-closed against unlisted venues).

level_construction.decision_time_immutability: The thesis invalidation published at decision time is IMMUTABLE. publishDecisionLevels deep-freezes decision-time levels; withRefreshedQuote returns a NEW package with the refreshed quote but carries the SAME frozen levels reference -- a refreshed quote never silently moves the invalidation.
level_construction.rebuild_policy: Explicit, named, validated choice. 'freeze-at-decision' (v1 rule): published levels === decision-time levels. 'rebuild-around-entry': levels mechanically rebuilt around the actual entry price with the SAME atr14 + riskMultiplier + direction; rebuild inputs and outputs both recorded. The v1 rule for the comparison is freeze-at-decision.
level_construction.validator: validatePublishedLevels(policy, decision, published, entryPrice) replays the declared rule from the recorded inputs and FAILS LOUDLY (LevelMismatchError) on any mismatch -- the check that would have caught the buildAtrLevels silent-rebuild bug (tested stop != published stop).
level_construction.veto_stop_alignment: auditVetoStopAlignment: the stop the issuance veto TESTED must equal the stop the ledger PUBLISHES; fails loudly otherwise.
level_construction.risk_math: crypto: riskPerUnit = 1.25 x Wilder ATR-14 (canonical, decision-time bars, complete window); invalidation = entry -/+ riskPerUnit by direction; target1 = entry +/- 1.5 x riskPerUnit; target2 = entry +/- 2.5 x riskPerUnit. equity: invalidation = 2.00x Wilder ATR-14 from the reference entry; targets 1.5R / 2.5R.

crypto.basis: First-touch barrier walk on 4h CoinGecko OHLC (candle-close timestamps; block covers [T-4h, T)). Interval-level, timestamp-aware (grade-2026-10-13-corr2.py semantics).
crypto.barrier_semantics: invalidation-first -> invalidated/MISS; target1-first -> target/HIT; both levels touched in one clean block -> AMBIGUOUS (excluded from hit rate).
crypto.issuance_boundary: block with close_ts <= issuance -> pre-entry, SKIPPED. Block with open_ts < issuance < close_ts -> STRADDLING: any touch inside it is TIMING-UNVERIFIED (terminal -- the touch cannot be ordered against issuance from OHLC).
crypto.uncertainty_hard_rule: Uncertainty once established is terminal. A later block NEVER erases uncertainty about an earlier overlapping touch. The walk STOPS at the first touch-or-uncertainty event.
crypto.horizon_cap: 30 elapsed days primary; checkpoints d5/d14/d30. Rows still open past the cap exit at the cap (time_exit).
crypto.costs: 18 bps round-trip modeled; funding UNVERIFIED (production convention). Net R = gross R - 18 bps.

source_files.role: corrected crypto grader: straddle handling, TIMING_UNVERIFIED, uncertainty-terminal hard rule

equity.basis: First-touch barrier walk on Yahoo daily bars from the signal date.
equity.barrier_semantics: same as crypto (invalidation-first MISS / target1-first HIT / same-bar double-touch AMBIGUOUS).

models.scoring_formula: usable = factors with finite contribution, finite weight, weight > 0 (walk-forward legacy factor excluded); weightedNet = SUM(contribution); totalWeight = SUM(weight); longScore = round(clamp(50 + (weightedNet/totalWeight)*42, 5, 95)); shortScore = 100 - longScore; direction = longScore >= shortScore ? long : short. NO_DATA -> score 0, never estimated.

levels.invalidation: entry -/+ riskPerUnit by direction (IMMUTABLE from decision time; validatePublishedLevels)

gates.born_dead: LONG suppressed if signal-day low <= invalidation; SHORT suppressed if signal-day high >= invalidation. Signal-day = latest completed UTC day from CoinGecko 4h OHLC.
gates.eligibility: no suppression AND sourceAsOf <= 30 min AND price != null AND (meme: $2M<=mcap<=$250M AND socialSnapshot) OR (main: volume24h>=$5M AND mcap>=$25M AND OI>=$1M AND funding != null).
gates.short_regime: applies to shorts ONLY: allowed iff priceBelowSma50 && (lowerHighs || trend20Negative); else suppressed.
gates.waiting_interval: checkWaitingInterval on [contract.decisionAt, entryObservedAt] against the FINAL published stop (see operational_rules.waiting_interval_veto).

readout_criteria.SUPPORT: n >= 30 paired definitive rows AND challenger d30-direction accuracy >= production + 10pp AND challenger mean net R >= production mean net R - 0.05 R/signal -> promote to production paper trial
readout_criteria.REJECT: n >= 30 paired definitive rows AND (challenger d30-direction accuracy <= production - 10pp OR challenger mean net R < production mean net R - 0.15 R/signal) -> retire C-2
readout_criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: n < 30 paired definitive rows, or gap < 10pp -> continue collecting; no promotion, no retirement

harness.writes: comparison row CSV/JSONL under goals/research-terminal/paper-signals/comparison/rows/. Never writes to any production table or holdout.
harness.decision_time_rule: Both arms are scored from decision-time inputs only. Any input dated after decisionAt fails the decision-time check: default labels the row decision_time_verified=false (never silently passes); strict mode raises LookaheadError. Inputs without asOf fields are labeled decision_time_verified=false ('asOf not recorded') -- never assumed. Date-only asOf values are normalized to UTC midnight in the row builder (documented per row); the harness itself is unchanged.
v2_deltas: MANIFEST_VERSION 1.0.0 -> 2.0.0: load_manifest() now requires the v2.0.0 freeze. Quarantined v1 rows are not re-scored.

New production_decision value 'qualified': scan-qualified radar candidates production never issued -> prod_disposition 'unscored' with new reason code unscored:production-not-issued. All scoring formulas, mirrored levels/gates, and other reason codes are byte-identical to v1.
The v1 unit-test suite (tests/) still passes; TestManifest now targets freeze-manifest-v2.0.0.json.
